properties.name: logging.masking.use-default-fields
properties.description: Includes the library's default PII field and secret header policy.

properties.name: logging.masking.additional-masked-fields
properties.description: Service-specific JSON field names to mask in addition to defaults.

properties.name: logging.masking.additional-secret-headers
properties.description: Service-specific HTTP header names to mask in addition to defaults.

properties.name: logging.masking.scan-packages
properties.description: Packages scanned for @Mask fields. Empty means the @SpringBootApplication packages.

properties.name: logging.masking.max-body-size
properties.description: Maximum payload size processed by manual LogMasker calls.

properties.name: logging.masking.mode
properties.description: Logback masking layer: encoder (default, wraps every appender) or off. Only an explicit, correctly spelled off disables it.

properties.name: logging.masking.field-strategies
properties.description: Field names grouped by masking strategy: last4 keeps the last four characters, hash replaces the value with a stable digest. Anything not listed is masked in full.
